classification.difficultyReason: Track elapsed time across named days and noon, and regroup hours, minutes and seconds using base-60 relationships.

content.prompt: Calculate the time elapsed, in hours, minutes and seconds, between:

children.label: a
children.prompt: 6 p.m. on Sunday and 6:25 a.m. on Tuesday

answer.worked:
From 6 p.m. Sunday to 6 p.m. Monday is 24 hours. From 6 p.m. Monday to 6:25 a.m. Tuesday is 12 hours 25 minutes.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Elapsed time}&=24\text{ h}+12\text{ h }25\text{ min}\\\text{Elapsed time}&=36\text{ h }25\text{ min }0\text{ s}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: 8:25 a.m. and 3:08 p.m. on the same day

answer.worked:
From 8:25 a.m. to noon is 3 hours 35 minutes. From noon to 3:08 p.m. is 3 hours 8 minutes.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Elapsed time}&=3\text{ h }35\text{ min}+3\text{ h }8\text{ min}\\\text{Elapsed time}&=6\text{ h }43\text{ min }0\text{ s}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: two finish times for a race: 03:34:21 and 04:25:56

answer.worked:
From 03:34:21 to 03:35:00 is 39 seconds. From 03:35:00 to 04:00:00 is 25 minutes. From 04:00:00 to 04:25:56 is 25 minutes 56 seconds.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Elapsed time}&=39\text{ s}+25\text{ min}+25\text{ min }56\text{ s}\\&=50\text{ min }95\text{ s}\\&=0\text{ h }51\text{ min }35\text{ s}\end{align*}$$
